channel.title: Pulse by Zerodha
channel.description: Latest financial and market news from all major Indian news sources aggregated in one place

item.title: UPI average daily transaction value crosses ₹1 trillion in October
item.description: Festive spending pushed UPI transactions to 25.47 billion, worth ₹31.53 trillion, even as the proposed merchant discount rate remains in focus

item.title: 10 penny stocks plunge up to 70% in three months. Do you own any?
item.description: Ten actively traded penny stocks have fallen between 34% and 73% over the past three months, highlighting the risks associated with low-priced shares. Cropster Agro recorded the steepest decline at 73%, followed by Bridge Securities and Empower India, which dropped 55% and 50%, respectively.

item.title: GST mop-up grows 23% to over ₹2.31 lakh cr. in October
item.description: Gross GST collections from domestic sales rose 16% to over ₹1.59 lakh crore, and revenues from imports climbed 42% to ₹72,246 crore

item.title: IOC, BPCL, HPCL clock Rs 30,106 cr Q2 profit, nearly 39 pc of last year's annual earnings
item.description: In the third quarter, spanning July to September, India's three major state-run fuel retailers announced a combined net profit of Rs 30,106 crore, reversing a previous loss of Rs 18,150 crore. This profitability surge defied the ongoing freeze on petrol and diesel prices since May. Indian Oil Corporation achieved its highest standalone quarterly net profit, buoyed by strong refining margins, yet faces ongoing challenges related to fuel under-recoveries.

item.title: Can Nifty, Sensex extend gains after rallying up to 2% last week? 4 factors to watch on Monday
item.description: Indian benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty ended the week higher, gaining up to 0.5%, even as broader markets declined amid rising crude oil prices above $117 a barrel. Investors will track oil price movements, foreign institutional investor (FII) activity, global cues and domestic market trends for direction. FIIs turned net buyers after a 10-week selling streak, lending support to sentiment.

item.title: FPIs pull out Rs 34,843 cr from equities in Oct; turn net buyers last week
item.description: Amidst rising economic fears, foreign portfolio investors withdrew Rs 34,843 crore from Indian equities in October. Although they had made significant contributions in July and August, outflows continued through September. By late October, a turnaround occurred as foreign investors became net buyers, infusing approximately Rs 6,300 crore into the market. Support from domestic institutional investors provided much-needed stability as all eyes turn to potential global impacts on investor sentiment.

item.title: Commercial LPG prices hiked ₹10/cylinder; ATF hiked ₹1.37/litre
item.description: The price of Aviation Turbine Fuel was also hiked by ₹1.37 per litre. It now costs ₹138.5 per litre

item.title: Bosch targets double-digit share in India's AC market within two years
item.description: The company is targeting to secure a place among the top five brands in the medium term

item.title: FPIs pull out ₹34,843 cr from equities in Oct, turn net buyers last week
item.description: According to data from the Central Depository Services Ltd (CDSL), FPIs withdrew ₹35,861 crore in September. Before that, they had invested ₹20,200 crore in July and ₹29,631 crore in August

item.title: Crypto Heist: Binance To Resume Withdrawals After Covering 95% Of $6.3 Billion Theft
item.description: The largest cryptocurrency exchange has said that it will restart phase 1 of withdrawals on Sunday after the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) linked the theft to North Korea.

item.title: ITC Q2 Results Preview: Profit seen falling nearly 30% YoY as cigarette tax hikes bite
item.description: ITC is expected to report a weak Q2, with brokerages forecasting an 8% decline in cigarette volumes and a drop of up to 29% in cigarette operating profit following tax hikes. Nuvama expects consolidated revenue to fall 3% YoY and EBITDA to decline 20%. Growth in FMCG and paper businesses could provide some cushion against the pressure.

item.title: NCERT To Release Class 10 Textbooks By December 2026 For Students To Prep In Advance
item.description: The early release of the CBSE Class 10 text books will be useful for students in Class 9 as they will get to explore the revised Class 10 syllabus and begin studying important topics earlier

item.title: Nifty IT’s 18% rally may mark a durable leadership cycle; 35,000 next: LKP's Vatsal Bhuva
item.description: Nifty IT’s 18% October rally could signal a sustained leadership cycle, supported by improving momentum, a bullish RSI crossover and capital rotation from global AI stocks. Analyst Vatsal Bhuva sees the index targeting 35,000. He remains cautious on Swiggy, bullish on Acutaas Chemicals, and recommends buying Persistent Systems and Eternal based on positive technical setups.

item.title: Ranabaali Box Office Collection Day 10: Vijay Deverakonda Film Recovers, Worldwide Gross Nears Rs 80 Crore
item.description: Ranabaali is set in South India in the 1870s and follows a warrior who fights against colonial rule during a time of famine.

item.title: IPO Calendar: Primary market cools after Jio frenzy, but 13 listings lined up
item.description: India’s IPO market is set for a quiet week, with just one fresh issue worth Rs 56.68 crore opening for subscription and no mainboard launches. Vedant Poly Fabs will be the only new IPO, while 13 companies are expected to list. The slowdown follows October’s blockbuster Rs 30,188 crore Jio Platforms IPO, which was subscribed over 22 times.

item.title: 'Fire Them By Friday': Chennai IT Manager's Anonymous Account Hits A Nerve
item.description: On Reddit, the account became the backdrop to a familiar Indian employment debate: how much is job security worth?

item.title: Sona Comstar expects annual investments to rise as business grows: MD
item.description: Singh shared that the company will continue investing across all its three business lines, adding that it had introduced three new products during the September quarter

item.title: IIM Bangalore Achieves 100% Summer Placement; 608 Students Secure Offers As Median Stipend Hits Rs 2 Lakh
item.description: The recruitment process was conducted between October 26-29 and covered students enrolled in the Post Graduate Programme in Management (PGP) and the Post Graduate Programme in Business Analytics.

item.title: Dividend Watchlist: Key Ex-Dates For Infosys, Mazagon Dock, Coal India And More Next Week
item.description: To be eligible for these payouts, investors must be mindful of the ex-dividend date, which is the day the share price adjusts to reflect the upcoming dividend.

item.title: Bangladesh Govt Forms Wage Board As Garment Workers Strike Shuts Factories. 140% Hike Next?
item.description: The dispute has raised ​concerns about disruption to an industry that employs about 4 ⁠million workers, generates more than 80% of Bangladesh's export earnings and supplies ​clothing to many leading Western brands.

item.title: Bonus issues, stock splits, dividends: Infosys, Asian Paints among over 40 stocks turning ex-date this week
item.description: More than 40 companies have scheduled record dates for dividends, bonus issues, rights issues and stock splits during November 2–6, 2026. Major names include Infosys, Asian Paints, Coal India, Power Grid and Info Edge, while Sanofi India will offer the week’s highest announced dividend of Rs 75 per share.

item.title: Binance says it has covered $6 billion of $6.3 billion stolen in hack
item.description: The ​remaining amount, now less than 10%, consists of assets that are less liquid and may take longer to source in the required ​amounts, according to Binance

item.title: Commercial LPG rates increase by ₹10, ATF prices up by ₹1.37 per litre
item.description: This is the fourth straight monthly increase in jet fuel (ATF) prices, necessitated by firming rates of international benchmarks

item.title: West Bengal Council of Higher Secondary Education Extends Class 12 Semester 3 Answer Key Challenge Deadline
item.description: Students will now have until 3 pm on November 2, 2026, to submit their challenges through the council's official portal.

item.title: Crude Tensions: OPEC+ To Keep Oil Targets Unchanged As Iran War Curbs Gulf Supply
item.description: OPEC+ is expected to hold fourth-quarter production targets steady before reviewing its 2027 output policy. Reports in July had already indicated the group would likely avoid further policy changes during this period.
